place_fields.vibe: peaceful, offbeat hill trek with broad views of surrounding Ramanagara hillocks
place_fields.summary: Yathiraja Swamy Betta is a short, relatively easy hill trek near Ibbalakahalli with rocky formations, a small cave near the top, and wide views across the surrounding hills.
place_fields.best_time: early morning; cooler conditions and clearer views are preferable

planning_attributes.description: A short hike in the Ramanagara area described as fairly easy and peaceful, with varied rock formations and 360-degree views of nearby hills.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Road approach from Bengaluru via Bidadi and Dharapura toward Yathiraja Swamy Betta; the attraction is in Ibbalakahalli, Karnataka 562159.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The summit includes rocky terrain and an exposed viewpoint; use care on steep or near-vertical sections and carry water.
planning_attributes.notes: Recent trek reporting describes the ascent as easy and the surroundings as quiet, with strong views across the Ramanagara hills.

place_fields.vibe: quiet, lesser-known hill fort trek with rocky terrain and panoramic valley views
place_fields.summary: Thalavadi Betta Fort is a lesser-known hill fort reached by a short trek through rocky and forested sections, with old fort remains at the summit and views toward Thimmappana Betta.
place_fields.best_time: early morning or late afternoon; daylight is recommended for the rocky summit section

planning_attributes.description: The route starts with an easy walk around the hill and ascends through rocky and forested stretches to ruined fort walls and the summit.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Remains of an old hill fort are present near the summit.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Approach from Bengaluru through Kanakapura, Kollegala and Thalavadi toward the hill; the final road to the trailhead is narrow and uneven.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Open access with no permit reported by the trail source.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The final summit section has steep rock-cut steps and requires careful footing; descent can be harder than ascent. The last road section can be slippery after rain.
planning_attributes.notes: The fort summit provides a view of Thimmappana Betta, also described as the Twin Peaks or Jodi Bande.

place_fields.vibe: scenic, short hill trek combining rocky formations, caves, shrines and open rural views
place_fields.summary: Kunagalu Betta is a hill trek near Kunagalu village featuring granite and rocky sections, caves, small shrines and a summit with wide views over surrounding fields, hills and the Arkavathi valley.
place_fields.best_time: post-monsoon or early morning/late afternoon for cooler walking conditions and clearer views

planning_attributes.description: The trail combines a motorable lower track with footpaths through boulders and a cave passage, followed by rocky sections and a summit viewpoint.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Ramanagara from Bengaluru via Mysore Road/NH275, then continue toward Kunagalu village and the trek base; local directions may be useful because signage can be limited.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: No prior permit is reported as required; open access is reported by the trail source.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Expect rocky and cave sections and some steep portions; use care on uneven ground. The final approach road can be narrow and rough, and vehicle parking should be handled near the designated/base area.
planning_attributes.notes: The summit area is associated with a distinctive puppy-face rock formation and small religious structures.
